body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 to the targeted Defense against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn and may move 1 unit toward a visible empty space.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary distraction penalty on the target's next Combat Card until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Divination
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it misses a Combat Card. Echo: reveal the defending creature's lowest Defense, then the protected target may move 1 unit.
